Task T5 complete:

- **`out/T5/solution.py`**: standalone PyTorch/safetensors script that loads the base checkpoint and PEFT-style adapter, maps `base_model.model.h.<i>.attn.c_attn.lora_{A,B}.weight` to base names, computes `scale * (B @ A).T` in float32 (accounting for the Conv1D `[in,out]` vs Linear `[out,in]` layout per `fan_in_fan_out`), merges into the 12 corresponding base tensors, runs the four required checks (12 pairs, no `lora_` names, `h.0.attn.c_attn.weight` shape, 160 total tensors), then shards into ≤100 MiB chunks (isolating the oversized `wte.weight`) and writes `model.safetensors.index.json`.
- Ran once, succeeded on the first execution: 160 tensors across 5 shards (shard 5 holds only `wte.weight`, 154 MB).
- **`out/T5/REPORT.md`** written per the template.
